description: Ministry of Labour - Industrial Disputes between Mr. Roshan Gnanapriya Agampodi and 02 others Vs. Urban Settlement Development Authority, Mr. C. D. Thilakarathna Vs. Lumiera Textiles (Pvt.) Limited, Ceylon Estate Staff''s Union Vs. R. P. C. Plantations Management Services (Pvt.) Ltd., and 03 others
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the appointment of arbitrators under the Industrial Disputes Act to settle specific labor disputes. It references legal statutes (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon), contains orders made under statutory authority (Section 4(1)), and deals with regulatory procedures for dispute resolution. While it mentions a government minister (Nimal Siripala De Silva), it does so in the context of exercising legal powers under specific legislation rather than making government personnel or structural changes. The content focuses on legal/regulatory mechanisms for industrial dispute settlement rather than government administration or personnel matters.
